question: Which OpenClaw browser or gateway report should own this Ubuntu managed-browser startup evidence, or should maintainers create a new canonical runtime report?
rationale: The affected implementation and validation environment are outside ClawHub, while the potentially related OpenClaw reports cannot be classified as the same root cause from their titles alone.

options.title: Route after root-cause match
options.body: Confirm the closest OpenClaw managed-browser startup report and transfer or cross-link this detailed evidence there.

options.title: Create canonical runtime report
options.body: Create a new OpenClaw runtime issue if existing reports do not match this Chrome-launch and CDP-readiness failure.

options.title: Request current diagnostics first
options.body: Keep this issue as a temporary routing stub while requesting a current OpenClaw version, gateway logs, and direct Chrome launch output.
